newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

Mangalia - no vessels operating. Midia - five livestock carriers, all loading.

Vyborg - Four vessels in port, all operating, no vessels waiting, no delays, 3 vessels due.

FAR EASTERN PORTS, Jan 21 - No strikes/delays/congestion. Vladivostok - 14 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (4 metal, 3 timber), 2 discharging/loading containers, 1 passenger vessel, 4 vessels waiting. Nakhodka - 12 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (3 metal, 3 timber, 1 cotton), 5 waiting. Vostochny - One vessel in port loading/discharging containers. Posyet, Zarubino - No vessels.

BLACK SEA, Jan 21 - Novorossiysk - 20 In port operating of which 13 loading (1 coal, 6 steel, 1 copper cathodes, 1 urea, 2 slabs, 1 seeds, 1 various). 7 Discharging (2 rice, 1 cars, 1 containers, 1 wine, 2 various). 16 Vessels waiting in roads of which 8 to load (5 steel, 1 molasses, 1 cast iron, 1 seeds). 8 To discharge (1 sugar, 3 rice, 1 sbm, 2 citrus, 1 luggage). 31 Vessels due of which 26 to load (3 scrap, 11 steel, 1 copper cathodes, cellulose, 2 paper, 1 grain, 1 aluminium, 1 seeds, 2 slabs, 1 coal, 1 fertiliser, 1 vegetable oil). 5 To discharge (2 maize, 2 bagged rice, 1 containers). Oil terminal, Jan 20 - 2 Tankers loading crude, 2 waiting to load crude, 2 due to load crude.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Six vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 apatite, 1 steel. 9 Vessels waiting of which 2 loaders (1 apatite, 1 npk), 7 alumina dischargers. 7 Vessels due during the week of which 6 loaders (2 apate, 1 scrap, 2 non-ferrous metals, 1 iron ore pellets), 1 anode paste discharger.

SLOVENIA, Jan 20 - Koper - 13 Vessels berthed of which 2 containers, 1 ferry loading/discharging, 4 vessels discharging (3 bulk carriers discharging salt, alumina and iron ore, 1 reefer discharging bananas). 4 Vessels loading, 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 2 livestock vessels loading bulls, 1 general cargo vessel loading sawn timber. 1 Tanker to discharge gasoline, 1 naval vessel on courtesy visit. 11 Vessels due over the next 2 days of which 2 container vessels to load,discharge, 3 car carriers to load/discharge cars, 1 bulk carrier to load coal, 2 livestock vessels to discharge bulls, 1 general cargo vessel to discharge potatoes, 2 reefers to discharge bananas. No delays expected.

Gijon - Stevedores strike ended
